source.product: UNIDENTIFIED - there is no real product behind this asset. A generic warm-Japandi oak bench with a fitted oatmeal linen cushion, invented for the FRIDAY demo catalogue. Not a copy of, and not a confirmed match for, any retail SKU.
source.generation: Higgsfield multi_image_to_3d, four cropped views (front / three-quarter-front-left / side profile / rear) taken from one AI-generated product turnaround sheet made with the codex-image skill; should_texture=true, enable_pbr=true, should_remesh=true, topology=triangle, target_polycount=30000, symmetry_mode=auto, no rigging or animation
source.postProcessing: gltf-transform resize --width 1024 --height 1024 (texture resize only, no lossy re-encode, geometry untouched), then scripts/fit_glb.py per-axis fit to stand the piece on the floor (minY = 0) and centre its footprint on x/z

knownLimitations: No real product: the dimensions below are the generated mesh's own measured box, not a figure verified against any retail listing.

This is the worst dimensional miss of the three. The target was 130 x 38 x 45 cm; the mesh reconstructed the bench far deeper and lower than drawn (190 x 69 x 57.2 cm as generated, a depth-to-width ratio of 0.36 against the intended 0.29), so fit_glb.py hit its 10% anisotropy cap and stopped at 130.0 x 43.4 x 39.6 cm. It is 5.4 cm too deep and 5.4 cm too low, and fit_glb.py exited 1 saying so. The declared dimensions here are the measured ones, so the piece is self-consistent; it is simply a chunkier, lower bench than the brief asked for.
catalogueListingId is a synthetic demo listing, not a real article number, and its price is invented demo data.
Visual quality is UNVERIFIED: no render of the GLB was inspected. Only the source turnaround sheet was reviewed by eye.
The four source views are AI-generated renders of a bench that does not exist, not photographs, so surface detail is plausible rather than accurate.
The linen cushion's soft rumpled surface and edge seam are carried by texture more than by geometry at this polygon budget.
No manual Blender inspection or correction pass has been done.
